trails.name: Gudbrandsdalsleden
trails.why: The Gudbrandsdalsleden was the main road to Trondheim and Nidaros Cathedral in the Middle Ages, walked by thousands of pilgrims.

trails.why: Bynuten lies at the eastern edge of Sandnes; from its 671 m summit you can see all the way to Stavanger on a clear day.

trails.name: Fottur til Frafjordhatten og Kjærlighetsstien
trails.why: At 815 m, Frafjordhatten is one of the majestic peaks of the outer Frafjord mountains.

trails.name: Liarvatnet rundt

trails.name: Tenål-Kallbakk
trails.why: The 2000 m to Varpet are relatively steep. Then on gravel road to Skorge. Marked path to Nyastoel and further to lake Kongsvatnet and to mountain summer farm Kallbakk at 744 m asl.

trails.name: Vangsnes-Kallbakk
trails.why: Behind the school in Vangsnes starts a 5 km long dirt road with a turning area at its end.

trails.name: Liasete
trails.why: Roundtrip partly following an old moutain summer farm route. From Kaalsete to Dalbotn, on to the moutain summer farm Liasete.

trails.name: Tømmervatnet rundt
trails.why: A very varied walk around Tømmervatnet, starting above the centre of Jørpeland.

trails.name: Ovriseggi
trails.why: Parking by road 13, approx. 500 m before the tunnel. Visible path over the mountain ridge to Daurmaalshaugen.

trails.name: Selvigstakken
trails.why: Selvigstakken, an alternative to Bynuten, sharing the same start and partly the same path.

trails.name: Randheimsrunden
trails.why: Ranheimsrunden is a 6.9 km route through lower Charlottenlund and Ranheim, along the shore and through varied neighbourhoods.

trails.name: Skard-Mulakamben
trails.why: From Skard to Middagshaugen at 750 m asl. Further on to Holten and on dirt road to Mulamyri.

trails.name: Fylkesgrensa-Hestavollen
trails.why: Starting point at parking close to the county boarder on road 13. The marked path leads in northeasterly direction.

trails.name: Preikestolen BaseCamp – Moslifjellet
trails.why: Moslifjellet, or Moslivarden, in the Preikestolen area, starting at the same point as the Preikestolen hike.

trails.name: Sentrumsrunden i Klæbu
trails.why: A 6 km loop through the centre of Klæbu that you can start wherever you like.

trails.name: Kålsete-Målsete
trails.why: From the parking lot at the ski centre, follow the marked path to Dalbotn, and then up to the path junction at Flatfjellet.

trails.name: Havsteinrunden
trails.why: Havsteinrunden is a 6.5 km local walk in Trondheim past Havstein and Kyvatnet to Sverresborg and down the old Gamle Åsvei.

trails.name: Preikestolen Basecamp
trails.why: The old back road to Preikestolen: before the car road was built in 1961, all guests had to walk this way to the hut.

trails.name: Preikestolen BaseCamp – Hengjandevatnet ved Ørnabu
trails.why: The goal is a scout hut by Hengjanevatnet, about 6 km from Preikestolen Fjellstue.

trails.name: Vokeskorane
trails.why: From Varpet on dirt road to mountain summer farm Ramberstoelen. From there on path in northeasterly direction to Veslaskardet.

trails.name: Skard-Legdene
trails.why: Parking at Skard. Path through hilly terrain, forest and high mountain area to the mountain summer farm Legdene.

trails.name: Turstien
trails.why: Easy, very well marked route in low terrain, but with good view over Balestrand some places.

trails.name: Kolgrovheia
trails.why: There are two routes to the top, one being slightly difficult but worth the effort. The other route has a trail with a steady climb, first through forest and then on bedrock.

trails.name: Åfet-Kallbakk
trails.why: Parking at the farm Afet. The first part of the hike is on a dirt road, then hiking path through forest and peaty terrain up to the mountain summer farm Kallbakk.

trails.name: Fottur til Kjerag og Kjeragbolten - majesteten i Lysefjorden
trails.why: A waymarked path of 8 km, +689 m, up to 1,017 m, from near Stavanger.

trails.name: Myklebust-Håskaret-Fjaler
trails.why: Easy trail with a slight grade. The trail partially follows a forest road. Old access road.

trails.name: Lunde-Vidasethovden
trails.why: The route starts from Lunde, at about 400 m a.s.l. The first part of the route goes through pine forest and the path is mostly dry.

trails.name: Halti summit
trails.why: Halti is a fell on the Norway-Finland border; at 1,324 m its shoulder is the highest point of Finland.

trails.name: Ráisduattarháldi summit

trails.name: Galdhøpiggen summit

trails.name: Storen summit
trails.why: Store Skagastølstind is the third highest peak in Norway. It is situated on the border between the municipality of Luster and Årdal in Vestland county, Norway.

trails.name: Skardstinden summit
trails.why: Skarstind is a prominent part of the Galdhøpiggen mountain range in northwestern Jotunheimen, Norway, and is the sixth highest summit in the country.

trails.name: Surtningssue summit
trails.why: Surtningssue is the seventh-highest mountain in Norway. It lies in Jotunheimen, on the border between the municipalities Lom and Vågå.

trails.name: Tjønnholstinden summit

trails.name: Leirhøe summit

trails.name: Besshøe summit

trails.name: Nautgardstinden summit

trails.name: Visbreatinden summit

trails.name: Høgdebrotet summit

trails.name: Langedalstinden summit

trails.name: Loftet summit

trails.name: Slettmarkpiggen summit

trails.name: Kyrkja summit
trails.why: Kyrkja is a mountain of Innlandet in southern Norway. Kyrkja is nicknamed “The Church”, because its peak is extremely steep and resembles a church spire.

trails.name: Nørdre Kalvehølotinden summit
trails.why: Nørdre Kalvehølotinden is a mountain of Oppland, in southern Norway. It is the 165th tallest peak in Norway.

trails.name: Trolltinden summit near Otta

trails.name: Storbreatinden summit

trails.name: Digerronden summit

trails.name: Storsmeden summit

trails.name: Veslesmeden summit
trails.why: Veslesmeden is a mountain in the Rondane mountain range, in the western part of Rondane often called Smiubelgen.

trails.name: Høgeloft summit

trails.name: Liaflui summit

trails.name: Storsylen summit

trails.name: Vangsen summit

trails.name: Råna summit

trails.name: Harahorn summit
trails.why: Harahorn, also written Harahødn, is a mountain located in the Hemsedal municipality in Norway.

trails.name: Blåkollen summit

trails.name: Slogen summit

trails.name: Skårasalen summit
trails.why: Skårasalen is a mountain in the municipality of Ørsta in Møre og Romsdal county, Norway. The 1,542-metre tall mountain has the seventh largest prominence of all mountains in Norway.

trails.name: Hornindalsrokken summit
trails.why: Hornindalsrokken is a 1,529-metre tall mountain in Møre og Romsdal county, Norway. It is located on the border of two municipalities: Stranda Municipality and Volda Municipality.

trails.name: Elgåhogna summit
trails.why: Elgåhogna, east of Femunden, the highest mountain of Engerdal and of southern Femundsmarka National Park.

trails.name: Helgelandsbukken summit
trails.why: Helgelandsbukken, a mountain in Meløy, Nordland.

trails.name: Innerdalstårnet summit
trails.why: Innerdalstårnet or Dalatårnet is a 1,452-metre tall mountain on the south side of the Innerdalen valley in Sunndal Municipality in Møre og Romsdal county, Norway.

trails.name: Lauparen summit
trails.why: Lauparen is a mountain on the border between Vestnes, Ålesund and Fjord in Møre og Romsdal.

trails.name: Bárrás summit

trails.name: Stor-Svuku summit
trails.why: Stor-Svuku, a mountain on the east side of Femunden in Femundsmarka National Park.

trails.name: Keipen summit near Geiranger
trails.why: Keipane, a mountain on the south side of the Geirangerfjord in Stranda.

trails.name: Svarvarnuten summit

trails.name: Forollhogna summit

trails.name: Saudehornet summit

trails.name: Napuren summit
trails.why: Napuren, a mountain on the border of Valle, Tokke and Fyresdal.

trails.name: Langlitinden summit

trails.name: Møysalen summit

trails.name: Ørneflag summit

trails.name: Tromsdalstinden - Sálašoaivi summit

trails.name: Moskkogáisi summit

trails.name: Skåla summit

trails.name: Vikerfjell summit

trails.name: Kvannfjellet summit
trails.why: Kvannfjellet, 981.4 m, in Hustadvika, once the highest point of the old Fræna municipality.

trails.name: Hedlo hut
trails.why: Hedlo, an old summer farm at 950 m on the western Hardangervidda, Eidfjord.

trails.name: Vågakallen summit
trails.why: Vågakallen is a mountain in Vågan Municipality in Nordland county, Norway. It has a height of 942 or 943 m.a.s.l., and is located in the island of Austvågøy in the Lofoten archipelago.

trails.name: Himmeltindan summit
trails.why: Himmeltindan, the highest mountain on Vestvågøy in Lofoten, with three summits.

trails.name: Hornelen summit
trails.why: Hornelen is a mountain in Bremanger Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. The mountain sits on the eastern end of the island of Bremangerlandet, along the Frøysjøen strait, in the Nordfjord region of Norway.

trails.name: Sveningen summit
trails.why: Sveningen is a mountain in Vestland county, Norway. The 842-metre tall summit of the mountain is a tripoint, marking the border of three municipalities: Bergen, Samnanger, and Bjørnafjorden.

trails.name: Patchellhytta hut
trails.why: Patchellhytta is a mountain hut in the Habostad valley of Sunnmøre, between the Brekketindane and Smørskredtindane peaks, just east of Slogen.

trails.name: Maifjellet summit
trails.why: Maifjellet, an 808 m mountain in Molde, Møre og Romsdal.

trails.name: Hausdalshorga summit
trails.why: Hausdalshorga is a mountain in the city of Bergen in Vestland county, Norway. It is located near the Gullfjellet mountain massif.

trails.name: Snøkolla summit
trails.why: Snøkolla or Snykolla is the highest mountain on the island of Langøya. The mountain is located in Øksnes Municipality in Nordland county.

trails.name: Mehammarsåto summit
trails.why: Mehammarsåta or Midhamarsåta is the highest mountain on the island of Stord in the municipality of Stord in Vestland county, Norway.

trails.name: Andersnatten summit
trails.why: Andersnatten is a mountain located at Eggedal in the municipality of Sigdal in Buskerud, Norway.

trails.name: Høgheia summit
trails.why: Høgheitinden or Heiane is a mountain in Hustadvika Municipality in Møre og Romsdal county, Norway.

trails.name: Møsnuken summit
trails.why: Møsnuken is a mountain in Bjørnafjorden Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. The 639-metre mountain lies about 3.5 kilometres east of the village of Søfteland.

trails.name: Lammanuten summit
trails.why: At 631 m, Lammanuten is the highest mountain of Tysvær in northern Rogaland.

trails.name: Schulzhytta hut
trails.why: Schulzhytta is a staffed hut at the Stormoen summer farms in Skarvan and Roltdalen National Park, Selbu.

trails.name: Trollheimshytta hut
trails.why: Trollheimshytta, a staffed mountain hut in the Trollheimen mountains.

trails.name: Trollvassbu hut
trails.why: Trollvassbu, a hut at 255 m in Tromsø, the northeasternmost of four huts on the trail from Snarbyeidet to Tromsdalen.

trails.name: Storsola summit
trails.why: Storsola, a mountain of the Sylan massif on the Norway-Sweden border, in Tydal.

trails.name: Skrikjofossen waterfall
trails.why: Skrikjofossen is a waterfall in Ullensvang Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. The falls are located about 3.5 kilometres southeast of the village of Lofthus.

trails.name: Valursfossen waterfall
trails.why: Valursfossen is a waterfall in Eidfjord Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is part of the river Veig, where it runs down from the Hardangervidda mountain plateau and down into the Valursdalen valley.

trails.name: Befjelltjønn summit
trails.why: Befjell, the highest point of Froland, just outside the Vereknutane nature reserve.

trails.name: Blåisvatnet - Jiehkkejávri lake
trails.why: Blåisvatnet, a lake at the foot of the Lenangsbreen glacier on the Lyngen peninsula.

trails.name: Grøttavatnet lake
trails.why: Grøttavatnet, a lake in Rauma, Møre og Romsdal, used as a reservoir for the Grytten power station.

trails.name: Stora Trastadalsvatnet lake
trails.why: The two Trastadal lakes at the head of the Henja valley in Sogndal, Vestland.

trails.name: Stortrollvatnet lake
trails.why: Stortrollvatnet, a small lake just northeast of Trollvasstinden in Rauma.
